# Levanta (Levanta.io Inc.)

Levanta is a Internet Marketplace Platforms company. Levanta is an Amazon Affiliate Marketing platform that helps Sellers build partnerships directly with revenue-generating creators, influencers, and affiliates. Levanta employs 79 people (+83.0% YoY, +44 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including United States, North Macedonia, China, Canada, and Argentina). Has $21.4M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

## About

Levanta is the unified creator and affiliate platform built for modern e-commerce. It enables brands and agencies to run one revenue-driving partnership program across Shopify, Amazon and Walmart, from discovery to payout, within a single system. Through its AI-powered Creator Marketplace, Levanta connects brands with high-performing publishers, influencers and affiliates while delivering complete visibility, incentive control, and cross-channel performance measurement.

## Volition Capital, which previously invested in Levanta’s Series A, is reinvesting as the company expands its creator commerce platform across the retail ecosystem

 August 27, 2026 09:00 ET | Source: Levanta 

SEATTLE, Aug. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Levanta, the creator affiliate platform for modern e-commerce, today announced a $22 million Series B investment led by Volition Capital, marking the firm’s second major investment in the company after leading its $20 million Series A in 2024. With this investment, Levanta has now raised more than $43 million in total funding. The new capital will support continued investment in Levanta’s creator commerce technology and go-to-market organization while accelerating its expansion across the retail ecosystem, including bringing dozens of additional retail marketplaces onto the platform and advancing the company’s vision for Creator Commerce Media. 

Volition Capital Doubles Down on Levanta Since its Series A, the company has expanded from its roots in Amazon affiliate marketing into a broader creator commerce platform spanning Amazon, Walmart, Shopify and other retail marketplaces, with 2026 revenue growth of 80% year-over-year. 

The platform has also broadened how brands discover, activate and measure creator partnerships. Levanta gives brands access to more than 90,000 vetted creators and millions more through AI-powered Social Discovery, while new capabilities like automated product sampling, flat-rate collaborations with affiliate-level measurement, and integrations with ChatGPT and Claude help brands move faster and make better decisions.

“We’re seeing a broader shift as brands and marketplaces increasingly look to creators and affiliates as measurable drivers of demand beyond their owned channels,” said Larry Cheng, founding partner at Volition Capital. “Levanta has built the infrastructure to connect that demand with commerce at scale, and we believe the opportunity ahead is substantially larger than when we first invested. We’re excited to continue partnering with Ian and the team as they deploy that infrastructure across the retail ecosystem to power Creator Commerce Media.”

The Next Evolution of Retail Media Retail media has traditionally focused on monetizing audiences and transactions that already exist within a retailer’s owned properties. Creator Commerce Media extends that model by helping marketplaces create new demand beyond their own channels.

The emerging category connects sellers’ marketing budgets with creators, publishers and affiliates who reach consumers across the open internet and drive them directly to commerce destinations. For marketplaces, it creates a new growth channel beyond onsite advertising. For brands, it provides a scalable way to activate creators across the places they sell. And for creators and affiliates, it opens access to a broader pool of commerce marketing spend.

# We’ve raised a $22 million Series B round led by Volition Capital, bringing our total funding to more than $43 million. | Levanta · LinkedIn · 2026-08-27

**Levanta**: Levanta is an Amazon Affiliate Marketing platform that helps Sellers build partnerships directly with revenue-generating creators, influencers, and affiliates. Levanta has 70-80 employees (+80% YoY), founded in 2023. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including United States, North Macedonia, China, Canada, and Argentina). Has $21.4M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

---

We’ve raised a $22 million Series B round led by [Volition Capital](https://linkedin.com/company/volition-capital), bringing our total funding to more than $43 million.

When Volition first led our Series A in 2024, Levanta was best known for [Amazon](https://linkedin.com/company/amazon) affiliate marketing. Since then, we’ve expanded across [Amazon](https://linkedin.com/company/amazon), [Walmart](https://linkedin.com/company/walmart), [Shopify](https://linkedin.com/company/shopify), and other retail marketplaces.

More than 90,000 vetted creators are now on our platform, with millions more available through AI-powered Social Discovery. We’ve launched automated product sampling, flat-rate collaborations with affiliate-level measurement, and integrations with ChatGPT and Claude.

Now we get to go even bigger. We’ll keep investing in our technology and GTM teams, bring dozens of additional retail marketplaces onto the platform, and continue building the infrastructure for #Creator Commerce Media.

There’s another part of this milestone that means a lot to us. Following the close of the Series B, Levanta provided cash liquidity to eligible employees, allowing members of our team to realize some of the financial value they have helped create while continuing to participate in the company’s future.

To the brands, agency partners, and creators who use Levanta to grow their businesses, thank you for trusting us. To our team, thank you for making all of this possible. And to Volition, thank you for doubling down on what we’re building together.
